about: Artifacts offered for download on /download/. A release appears once engineering's promotion record approves an exact artifact; it stays 'awaiting the owner's approval', with no download link and no file in any build, until approval.owner names the owner's written approval of that SHA-256 in engineering's docs/DECISIONS.md. The build renders each release and refuses an incomplete record; check.mjs fails on any installer link that is not listed here. Fields: version, stage (private alpha, developer alpha, developer beta, stable), date (YYYY-MM-DD), notes, approval {promotion: the engineering record and its commit, owner: empty until the owner's written approval, then the DECISIONS.md entry, its commit and date; cohort: empty until the testers are named and recorded}, install (sentences shown under 'Before you install'), artifacts [{platform, file, url (https), bytes, sha256, signature}], withdrawn (when and why a release was taken down; its record stays, but it never renders and its file never ships).

releases.withdrawn: 2026-10-29, by the owner's decision D-030 in the engineering repository's docs/DECISIONS.md (commit 851f275): the file and the app inside it carried the project's earlier name. The file was removed from the stage-snapshot alias and from its download page the same day. Version 0.1.1, under the current names, replaces it only after its own promotion record and the owner's approval of its SHA-256.
releases.notes: Private-alpha candidate 1 of the UCompute desktop app for macOS, built from the development source on 24 October 2026, for invited testers only. This record uses the current names; the build it describes carried the earlier name, and the original record is in this repository's git history.
